name: bonding_bond_create_8d6184e4881b

history.subject: bonding: fix device leak on error in bond_create()

bug: A real bug that shipped in Linux until 2010: when register_netdevice() fails, bond_create() returns without free_netdev(), leaking the net_device allocated by alloc_netdev_mq(). Upstream commit 8d6184e4881b added the release; removing it from Linux 6.18.55 restores the original bug.
reachable: bonding_init() calls bond_create() for each of max_bonds (default 1) at module load and propagates its error, so failing an allocation inside register_netdevice() with fail-nth makes initialisation fail and leaves the net_device unreferenced.
reference: Historical bug re-introduction: the fix is the upstream patch.
